morphy.heroSubtitle: The next generation of modular and adaptable wall bed systems by Wall Bed King.
morphy.twoWaysTitle: Two ways to flex your space
morphy.twoWaysDesc: Morphy isn’t just a bed — it’s a complete, next-generation modular sleeping system designed to adapt to your life. With our SizeFlex™ and TypeFlex™ innovations, one frame can transform, resize, and reimagine itself. Whether you move homes, grow your family, or simply want a new look, your Morphy evolves with you — without compromise.
morphy.sizeFlexTitle: SizeFlex™ — your bed that grows with you
morphy.sizeFlexDesc: Why buy a new bed every time your needs change? With SizeFlex™, your Morphy can grow from Single to Double, Queen, or even King size — all using the same base components. Our modular frame system features universal parts that connect and expand easily. When you’re ready for a bigger bed, simply order the additional modules you need and reconfigure your existing frame — no need to replace the whole system. Morphy currently supports 16 different size configurations.
morphy.typeFlexTitle: TypeFlex™ — reimagine your space, your way
morphy.typeFlexDesc: Your Morphy isn’t limited to one purpose. With TypeFlex™, the same base can be transformed into a wall bed, storage bed, ottoman bed, or even a bunk bed. Start simple — then upgrade at your own pace. Add panels to turn it into a Morphy Studio wall bed, or add modules such as desks, cabinets, or sofas. Every component connects seamlessly, giving you complete freedom to design your perfect setup.
morphy.orientationDesc: Change your mind, not your furniture. Morphy’s universal base lets you install the same bed vertically or horizontally—even years after your purchase. Avoid costly exchanges, adapt your bed with ease, and make any room truly yours.
morphy.upgradeableDesc: Start with a simple Classic and upgrade anytime: add a cabinet, switch to Studio, or integrate side units, sofas, or desks (module options launching soon!). With Morphy, your bed isn’t fixed—it evolves alongside your needs, giving you total control and lasting value.
morphy.warrantyDesc: Morphy isn’t locked into one purpose. Transform it from a wall bed to an ottoman, bunk, or traditional frame as life changes. Lifetime warranty means long-lasting quality, and modular reuse means you’ll never need to discard your bed when styles or needs change. Choose sustainability, choose Morphy.
morphy.modulesSoonDesc: Get ready to personalize your space like never before! Our sleek new sofa module, versatile desk module, and smart storage units are designed to perfectly complement and expand your Morphy bed—effortlessly transforming your space for work, rest, and play.

about.title: Engineering Precision Murphy Beds for Modern Living
about.subtitle: Discover how WallBedKing revolutionised European space-saving furniture with unmatched mechanism reliability.
about.storyHeading: Designed for everyday living, not just guest rooms.
about.storyP1: Modern living spaces—whether in London apartments, regional family homes, or contemporary studios—are more multifunctional than ever. Yet conventional beds permanently consume over 80% of floor space in bedrooms, guest rooms, and home offices.
about.storyP2: Wall Bed King was founded to disrupt this dilemma. By manufacturing our own cold-rolled steel mechanisms and pairing them with counterbalanced gas struts and sprung birch wood slats, we eliminated the clunky, heavy springs and flimsy frames of yesterday. The result is an effortless, feather-light foldaway bed engineered for decades of daily use.

support.safetyAnchoring: The bed frame must be solidly anchored to a masonry wall, timber wall studs, or directly into a solid subfloor. Never rely solely on plasterboard fixings.
support.safetyPistons: Never attempt to compress the gas struts before they are mounted to the frame. The pistons operate under high internal pressure and require the mechanical leverage of the assembled bed.
support.safetyTeam: While the assembly is straightforward, we strongly recommend two adults for lifting and hanging the inner frame onto the pivot brackets.
support.stepsTitle: 5 Simple Steps to Complete Your Setup
support.step1Tip1: Clear a working space of at least 3m x 2.5m on a clean, soft floor (carpet or cardboard) to avoid scratching the powder-coated steel frame.
support.step1Tip2: Unpack the cartons and identify the parts using the included hardware blister pack: main outer frame, inner bed frame, sprung birch slats, plastic slat caps, gas piston cylinders, and mounting brackets.
support.step1Tip3: Verify the wall and floor structure: ensure there are no hidden electrical cables or plumbing pipes in the drilling zone.
support.step2Tip1: The Wall Bed King mechanism offers unique flexibility: you can anchor the brackets to a solid wall, to the floor, or both.
support.step2Tip2: Solid Masonry Walls (Brick / Concrete): Use the heavy-duty wall anchors provided. Drill 10mm holes at the marked heights, insert rawl plugs, and securely bolt the L-brackets.
support.step2Tip3: Stud Walls (Plasterboard / Drywall): Never fix into hollow plasterboard alone! Locate the vertical timber or metal studs using a stud finder and secure the brackets directly into the structural studs.
support.step2Tip4: Floor Fixing: If wall fixing is not possible, the mounting brackets can be secured directly into a concrete slab or solid timber floorboards.
support.step3Tip1: Assemble the rectangular outer frame using the M8 corner bolts and tighten securely with a 13mm socket.
support.step3Tip2: Attach the heavy-duty pivot brackets to the left and right uprights.
support.step3Tip3: Position the outer frame against your wall and level it carefully using your spirit level before fully tightening the anchor bolts.
support.step4Title: 4. Inner Bed Frame & Gas Piston Installation
support.step4Tip1: Assemble the inner bed frame that will support the mattress.
support.step4Tip2: Carefully align the inner frame with the outer frame pivot brackets and insert the heavy-gauge pivot pins with locking nylon nuts.
support.step4Tip3: Attach the German gas piston cylinders: Ensure the piston rod points downwards when the bed is closed. Hook the gas struts onto the ball joints and snap the safety retaining clips into place.
support.step4Tip4: Caution: Do not attempt to compress the gas pistons by hand! They are calibrated to balance the combined weight of the frame and mattress.
support.step5Tip1: Slide the plastic slat caps onto both ends of the curved birch wood slats.
support.step5Tip2: Press the caps firmly into the pre-drilled holes along the bed frame until they snap securely into position.
support.step5Tip3: Place your mattress onto the frame. Lower the bed completely to test the counterbalanced tension.
support.step5Tip4: Fasten the heavy-duty mattress retention straps across the mattress to keep bedding securely in place when folded up.

privacy.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: January 2026 • Wall Bed King (IZN Ltd)
privacy.sec1P1: Wall Bed King (operated by IZN Ltd) is committed to protecting the privacy and confidentiality of our customers. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect when you visit our website, place an order, or speak with our support team, and how that information is handled in accordance with the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.sec2Intro: We may collect and process the following information:
privacy.sec2Contact: Contact Details: Your name, billing address, delivery address, email address, and phone number.
privacy.sec2Order: Order Information: Products purchased, dimensions, options, transaction reference, and delivery instructions.
privacy.sec2Tech: Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, and pages visited (via cookies).
privacy.sec2Comm: Customer Communications: Records of correspondence if you contact our sales or technical support teams.
privacy.sec3Intro: Your personal information is used solely for legitimate business purposes:
privacy.sec3P1: To process and fulfill your order, including scheduling delivery and communicating shipping updates.
privacy.sec3P2: To handle payments securely via authorized payment gateways (e.g. PayPal, Worldpay).
privacy.sec3P3: To provide customer support, warranty verification, and technical assembly guidance.
privacy.sec3P4: To improve our website functionality and user experience.
privacy.sec3Outro: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third-party advertisers.
privacy.sec4P1: All online card payments are processed using 256-bit Secure Socket Layer (SSL) encryption through Level 1 PCI-DSS compliant payment providers. We do not store or process payment card numbers on our servers.
privacy.sec4P2: We retain customer order records only for as long as necessary to satisfy accounting, legal, and warranty obligations under our Lifetime Mechanism Warranty.
privacy.sec5P1: Under UK and EU data protection regulations, you have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you, request corrections, or request erasure of your data where no overriding legal or warranty obligation applies.
privacy.sec5P2: To exercise any of these rights, please email our Data Privacy Officer at support@wallbedking.com.
